verdict.rationale: Ramp is a regulated fintech SaaS (card issuance, banking, bill pay) built on partnered banking rails (e.g., First Internet Bank of Indiana) and centralized compliance/fraud infrastructure — self-hosting is a category error for this kind of product, not an open-source platform a customer could run themselves. Evidence shows extensive API/CLI/MCP openness for integration, but none of it constitutes or implies a self-hostable core product.
